Package iLock_Geography :: Module geo_attributes
[frames] | no frames]

Module geo_attributes

The module defines a number of extra geography attributes.

Variables
str RY_OBJECT_NAME = register("__ryObject__")
PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the railyard object it was created from.
str RY_TYPE_NAME = register("__ryType__")
PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the user type of the railyard object it was created from.
str LAYOUT_EDITOR_OBJECT = register("__leObject__")
Railyard-PiSPEC attribute that is set to true if the corresponding railyard object is created by the layout editor.
str NODE_X_POS = register("XPosition")
Node coordinate attribute that keeps the X position.
str NODE_Y_POS = register("YPosition")
Node coordinate attribute that keeps the Y position.
str X_COORD = register("__XCoord__")
Object coordinate attribute that keeps the X position.
str Y_COORD = register("__YCoord__")
Object coordinate attribute that keeps the Y position.
str RY_PATH_START_OBJECT = register("start_obj")
PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the start railyard object of a path.
str RY_PATH_END_OBJECT = register("end_obj")
PiSPEC instance attribute that keeps the name of the end railyard object of a path.
